visual_shadow_review: Inspected all 23 virtual images at overview and four-to-eight-channel detail scale, all ten measured/virtual pairs in the contact sheet, and a registered 512-pixel crop of H&E, DAPI/Hoechst and CD68. No straight rectangular tiling seam or border shadow is apparent. The dark upper-left tissue/empty-field area follows the source field rather than a rectangular processing border. This finding is limited to this CRC04 window.
dapi_review: Virtual DAPI follows many measured Hoechst nuclear regions, but peaks are much broader and brighter than individual nuclei. Full-tissue pixel rank agreement does not measure nuclear intensity fidelity.
protein_review: Several virtual protein channels share broad morphology and fail to reproduce sparse measured immunofluorescence. The raw-pixel Spearman values include CD68 -0.305, PD-1 -0.001, CD20 0.066, CD8 0.053, CK/Pan-CK 0.257, and Ki67 0.489. The CK and DAPI pair names are antigen-family mappings, not exact quantitative equivalents. Protein-specific validity is not established.
limit: One previously QC-passing patient is insufficient for the required cross-patient protein correlation. Technical DAPI and seam passes cannot certify the biological accuracy of every virtual marker.
